title: Open Problems on Billiards and Geometric Optics
exact_target: For the cylinder-and-two-caps surface, ask whether its geodesic return map has invariant curves, including KAM curves near grazing directions, which shapes besides circles give integrability, and whether it can be ergodic.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 5200001 (AMR-051-0001). CC BY 4.0.
M. Bialy, C. Fierobe, A. Glutsyuk, M. Levi, A. Plakhov and S. Tabachnikov, \emph{Open problems on billiards and geometric optics} (2021), arXiv:2110.10750v2, Misha Bialy, Problem 1, pp. 1--2.
